brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / editorial sports thumbnail.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536x864 pixels or larger, PNG. This is a new original illustration, not a photograph.

Approved visual direction: match the viewed black-and-lime basketball sample's bold Japanese typography, near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B brush streaks, ivory lettering, hand-inked sports illustration, confident sparse editorial composition. Do not copy the sample's player, name, date, statistics or team information. Make a fresh composition: player on the RIGHT, diagonally pivoting into a forceful two-handed pass with the ball at chest/waist level, knees bent and torso turning, three-quarter view with face clearly visible. Orange basketball is held as a prop. No additional people. No hoop or match-specific venue necessary. This is a conceptual play illustration, not a recreation of an actual game moment.

The only athlete is the real Kerry Blackshear Jr. (ケリー・ブラックシアー・ジュニア), the article's main subject. His official B.LEAGUE profile photo has been visually checked: https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/713/2026-27/51000145_03.png (profile https://www.bleague.jp/roster_detail/?PlayerID=51000145). Match the viewed official portrait's recognizable facial features: very close-cropped black buzz cut, long oval face, medium-brown skin translated into expressive monochrome ink and warm gray shading, slightly narrow relaxed eyes and strong eyebrows, prominent straight nose with rounded broad base, medium-full lips, short neat mustache and close short beard around chin and jaw, athletic broad shoulders and tall long-limbed build. He must look like this actual player, not a generic invented athlete. Keep face clear and sufficiently large. Give him a plain dark sleeveless basketball jersey with ivory highlights and a plain black sleeve on his left arm. NO letters, numbers, team marks, league marks, sponsor text, brand logos, tattoos added, or copied photographic pixels. All body, face, jersey and ball must be visibly drawn in ink with brush hatching; no photorealism.

Design: left roughly 55 percent is clean text, right roughly 45 percent is the player, with a lime sweeping brush shape behind him. Maintain strong text/figure separation, generous edge margins, and no clipping of any text, head, hands or ball. Hands anatomically plausible with proper fingers and grip. The lower torso may end naturally at bottom, but keep important play gesture in frame.

Text exactly as follows, no extra copy:
At upper left, small ivory:
「バスケまとめ」
「2026.11.06」
Large ivory headline below:
「貢献度1位」
Largest central stat: 「EFF 44」, EFF clearly associated with 44, 44 in vivid lime brush numerals. This is an efficiency figure, NOT 44 points. Do not add 得点 next to 44.
Below stat, clear bold ivory name across two lines:
「ケリー・ブラックシアー」
「ジュニア（群馬）」
Bottom left footer, legible small ivory with breathing room:
「イラスト（AI生成）」
「成績をもとにしたイメージ」

Content grounding ONLY in supplied fixed source.html/source.txt: date 2026-11-06; daily contribution ranking 1st is Kerry Blackshear Jr., Gunma, EFF 44. Do not imply a season ranking, MVP award, nationality classification, a decisive play or game reenactment. Avoid scores, additional stats and unsupported superlatives. Footer explicitly distinguishes illustration from documented scene. Correct every Japanese glyph, punctuation and number. Crisp professional typography, very high contrast, fewer elements, no watermarks or decorative pseudo-text.
